class.name: JRPGInterpreter
class.brief_description: Runs event commands, one simulation step at a time.
class.description: Runs a [JRPGCommandList] with a stack of frames, each a list and the index of the next command in it. A branch command pushes the child list it takes ([method push_list]); when that list ends, the interpreter goes on after the branch. A loop frame starts its list again when it ends, until a command breaks out ([method break_loop]). [method jump_to_label] looks for the label in the current list, then in the lists around it. Time is counted in 60 Hz simulation steps: [method step] runs commands until one waits ([method wait_steps], or a command that returns [constant JRPGEventCommand.EXECUTE_WAIT] and runs again at the next step), the commands end, or the step's budget is spent ([constant MAX_COMMANDS_PER_STEP] commands, [constant MAX_JUMPS_PER_STEP] loop restarts and jumps), in which case it goes on at the next step. Commands receive the interpreter as their context, and read and change the game state through [method get_game_state]. Nothing depends on the frame rate or the wall clock. Authority: server. Online, the zone runs interpreters; presentation goes to the clients.

method.name: break_loop
method.description: Leaves the innermost running loop (and any list inside it); the list around it goes on after the loop command. Returns [code]false[/code], with nothing changed, when no loop is running.

method.name: call_common_event
method.description: Runs the commands of common event [param id] next, then goes on after the current command. Returns [code]false[/code], with a warning, when the common event does not exist or [constant MAX_DEPTH] frames already run (a common event that calls itself).

method.name: clear
method.description: Drops everything under way: the interpreter is idle. A command may clear its own interpreter (a transfer that stops the map's parallel processes does): the step ends there.

method.name: exit
method.description: Exit Event Processing: ends the current event's contents. Inside a common event the run called ([method call_common_event]), that is the common event: the caller goes on after the call. Otherwise the run ends.

method.name: get_current_command
method.description: Returns the command being run or the next one to run, or [code]null[/code] when idle.

method.name: get_depth
method.description: Returns how many frames are running ([code]1[/code]: only the list it started with).

method.name: get_event_id
method.description: Returns the event the run belongs to ("this event"), or [code]0[/code].

method.name: get_event_map_id
method.description: Returns the map of the event the run belongs to, or [code]0[/code].

method.name: get_game_state
method.description: Returns the game state the commands read and change.

method.name: get_indexes
method.description: Returns the index of the next command in each frame, outermost first: where the run is.

method.name: get_next_command
method.description: Returns the command after the current one in the same list, or [code]null[/code] where the list ends.

method.name: get_owner
method.description: Returns the name of what runs it, used in warnings.

method.name: get_port
method.description: Returns the presentation port the interpreter asks the player through.

method.name: get_reply
method.description: Returns the answer that made [method present] return [code]true[/code].

method.name: get_wait_left
method.description: Returns how many more simulation steps the interpreter waits before the next command.

method.name: is_running
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while commands are left to run.

method.name: jump_to_label
method.description: Goes on after the label [param label] (see [method JRPGEventCommand.get_label]) in the current list or a list around it. Returns [code]false[/code], with a warning, when there is no such label there; the run then goes on after the jump.

method.name: present
method.description: For commands that ask the player. The first time the current command runs, sends a request of kind [param kind] with [param params] to the presentation port and returns [code]false[/code]: the command returns [constant JRPGEventCommand.EXECUTE_WAIT] and runs again at the next step. Once the player answered, returns [code]true[/code], and [method get_reply] gives the answer. Without a port the request is answered at once with [code]null[/code], with one warning. A request is not saved with the game: after loading, the command runs again and asks again.

method.name: push_list
method.description: Runs [param list] next, then goes on after the current command. With [param loop], the list starts again each time it ends. An empty branch ([code]null[/code]) does nothing.

method.name: restore
method.description: Goes on from [param state] (as [method serialize] wrote it) with [param root] as the list the run started with, [param game_state] as the game state and [param owner] naming it in warnings. Returns [code]false[/code], leaving the interpreter idle, when the state cannot be read, a list cannot be found or its commands are no longer the saved ones; the caller decides whether the run starts again or is dropped.

method.name: serialize
method.description: Returns where the run is, for a save: [code]frames[/code], outermost first, each with the [code]index[/code] of its next command, [code]loop[/code], where its list comes from ([code]child[/code]: which child list of the command that pushed it, or [code]common_event[/code]: the common event called) and the [code]hash[/code] of its commands ([method JRPGCommandList.get_content_hash]); and [code]wait[/code], the steps left to wait. An idle interpreter has no frames. Lists are named by where they come from, never by object, so a save survives loading the map again.

method.name: set_event
method.description: Sets the map event the run belongs to, which commands mean by "this event": event [param event_id] of map [param map_id]. [method start] forgets it; the event runner sets it for each run, and a common event the run calls keeps it.

method.name: set_port
method.description: Sets the presentation port the interpreter asks the player through. A request waiting on the previous port is withdrawn.

method.name: start
method.description: Starts running [param list] from its first command, with [param state] as the game state. Anything under way is dropped. [param owner] names it in warnings.

method.name: step
method.description: Runs one simulation step and tells how it ended.

method.name: wait_steps
method.description: Waits [param steps] simulation steps after the current one before the next command.

constants.constant: No commands are left: the interpreter is idle.
A wait or a waiting command stops the run until a later step.
The step's budget is spent: the run goes on at the next step.
The most commands one step runs.
The most loop restarts and jumps one step makes.
How many frames deep (lists inside lists and common event calls) a common event can still be called: deeper calls are skipped with a warning, which ends a common event that calls itself.
Steps in a row that spend their whole budget before a warning: a loop that never waits.
